name: Flint Secondtry
props: short blunt antler tool and one chipped flint handaxe
visual: low wide splat, one eye clenched in concentration, bitten-in closed lip, shoulders raised
personality: A perfectionist who is still on the first draft.
biography: He sorts the building's contradictory cards into sharp and insufficiently sharp.
note: FrizzleBob: The Stone Age is waiting for his final polish.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Bram Bigidea
props: oversized stone hammer on a very short wood handle
visual: tall crooked droplet, enormous delighted eyes, small triumphant two-upper-tooth smile
personality: Treats every impact as a breakthrough.
biography: He wants the Men in Black to patent a method of making uncertainty flatter.
note: FrizzleBob: Peer review is conducted with the same hammer.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Oona Hearthwise
props: shallow clay bowl of dark cold charcoal with one tiny ember
visual: round soft square, one raised eyelid, compressed sideways pout, elbow firmly tucked
personality: Patient with fire and spectacularly impatient with advice.
biography: She keeps the HyperNorm hearth orderly, assigning troublesome ideas to the cold side of the bowl.
note: FrizzleBob: She has domesticated fire. The household remains difficult.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Gus Mammothmaybe
props: stubby wood spear with blunt stone tip and a little tuft of shed mammoth fur tied to shaft
visual: lean tilted pear, huge offset gaze toward fur, teeth tucked behind trembling lower lip
personality: Hears a large animal in every small silence.
biography: Hunky and Dory ask for confidence; Gus submits increasingly detailed footprints.
note: FrizzleBob: His evidence has begun following him home.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Pippa Ochremark
props: short ochre crayon and small flat rock with one simple handprint
visual: broad asymmetrical heart-shaped blob, one eye rolled up in inspiration, skew wide open laugh with teeth inside mouth
personality: Sees an unapproved mural in every empty wall.
biography: She covers dissonant cards with handprints, then privately admires what shows through.
note: FrizzleBob: The first artist has already received a request for something more neutral.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Ned Provisions
props: small reed basket with three enormous clay berries
visual: compact bean with lopsided lobes, narrow side-eye, crooked tight closed smile
personality: Counts lunch as a strategic reserve.
biography: The Men in Black praise his neat categories: edible, inedible, and not yet authorized.
note: FrizzleBob: The third category has eaten most of the basket.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.
